en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Idrees, from Muhammed bin Ahmad, from Muhammed ibn Hussain, from Ibn Sinan, from Hudhaifa bin Mansur, that he said: I heard Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, say:
The one who is Arabized after migration is (like) an abandoner of this matter (of belief) after having known it.
